title: Deeper/broader ACadRust crosswalk and BLOCK_RECORD XDATA output gap
mode: Primary-source web review plus local source inspection; plan-only update
scope: Refresh ACadRust issue and release claims for malformed-DWG handling, owner retention, MLeader context boundaries, custom classes, color-book names, and table-record XDATA
Check the exact current source/release identity boundary before attributing peer behavior to a released artifact
Screen a newly surfaced DXF project for open-source reuse eligibility
Trace BLOCK_RECORD XDATA through the local parser, concrete adapter, pending writer, and record emitter
Update the plan with only locally actionable work, retaining fast validation and external-evidence boundaries

method.kind: Read primary project issue/release/source pages and inspect local code/tests/plan
method.limitations: Peer reports and release notes were not independently reproduced. The local BLOCK_RECORD XDATA omission is confirmed by source-path inspection, but the generated end-to-end regression has not yet been run; 7CA.1 is explicitly the first implementation action. No peer claim is treated as normative format evidence or as a local support claim.

sources.revision: Public issue, v0.6.4 release, and mutable main manifest reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: Issue #132 reports raw-only custom class, group-430 color-book, and table/block-record XDATA losses on its 0.6.3 route. The v0.6.4 release notes claim fixes for named colors, table-record XDATA, and unsupported custom records, but the issue remains open without a reporter retest in the reviewed page. The current main manifest says 0.6.5 while the GitHub release page identifies v0.6.4 as latest; source and release artifacts are not interchangeable evidence.
sources.limits: No ACadRust build or issue artifact was run. The release note does not independently prove BLOCK_RECORD XDATA round-trip behavior.

sources.observed: The reviewed reports concern malformed-input allocation/count/header boundaries, owner re-homing/phantom dimensions, and an AC1032 MLeader context boundary. Candidate commits or requests for retest are not independent confirmation of those fixes.
sources.limits: These are version- and corpus-bound peer signals, not DWG format rules or demonstrated libdxfrw defects. No peer corpus or executable was used.

sources.revision: Public README and license statement reviewed 2026-10-18
sources.observed: The repository describes bounded ASCII/Binary DXF behavior but states that public visibility/evaluation does not grant unrestricted production, modification, or redistribution rights.
sources.limits: Excluded from the open-source comparator set. No clone, build, execution, source reuse, fixture reuse, or derived corpus use.

sources.observed: DRW_Block_Record inherits typed XDATA through DRW_TableEntry::extData. The existing test checks import. The dx_iface write bridge passes name, insertion units, and preview data; the pending BLOCK_RECORD representation and emitBlockRecord path have no XDATA storage/emission. The source path therefore lacks preservation on adapter-mediated DXF output.
sources.limits: Source inspection confirms the missing path but is not yet an end-to-end runtime reproduction. Verify with the generated ASCII/Binary control in 7CA.1 before production edits.

assessment.finding: PAR-131: BLOCK_RECORD XDATA is retained by the DXF reader but not carried through the concrete adapter and pending writer to DXF output.
assessment.subplan: 7CA: reproduce with a generated ASCII/Binary round-trip control, then carry owned typed XDATA through precollection and emission, preflight APPID dependencies, preserve code-1005 handle remapping, and verify destination transactionality with focused tests.

workingTree.reason: The repository already contains extensive user modifications. This pass is limited to the existing plan and its research receipt; no files are staged or committed.
